lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You lied on paper and the paper believed you. The doors opened. The cameras blinked. The congratulations sounded the same as if you’d earned them.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: No one came knocking. No investigation. No audit. Just silence and a calendar moving forward.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: But every request that followed asked for the person you pretended to be. Every task wanted the skills your documents promised. The gap widened.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: You didn’t get caught. You just got lost. It turns out getting away with it is another kind of sentence.
